definitions.explanation: Wind and snow together, as a weather condition; a snowstorm. Used in weather reports and written descriptions.
Figuratively, the hardships of life or of a long history, especially in the set phrase {風雪|ふうせつ}に{耐|た}える (to endure hardships). Written, somewhat literary.

examples.japanese: {風雪|ふうせつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}まる→強まる：02295_tsuyomaru⟧。
examples.english: The wind and snow are getting stronger.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今夜|こんや}→今夜：01411_konya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{風雪|ふうせつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please watch out for wind and snow tonight.

examples.japanese: ⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧{風雪|ふうせつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{山小屋|やまごや}→山小屋：18402_yamagoya⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{出|で}られなかった→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: Because of the fierce snowstorm, we couldn't leave the mountain hut.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧{風雪|ふうせつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{耐|た}えて→耐える：12087_taeru⟧きた。
examples.english: It has endured long years of hardship.

examples.japanese: ⟦{百年|ひゃくねん}→百年：28401_hyakunen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{風雪|ふうせつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{耐|た}えた→耐える：12087_taeru⟧⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{寺|てら}→寺：01676_tera⟧だ。
examples.english: It is an old temple that has weathered a hundred years.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{幾多|いくた}→幾多：12642_ikuta⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{風雪|ふうせつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乗|の}り{越|こ}えて→乗り越える：04620_norikoeru⟧きた⟦{強|つよ}さ→強さ：25692_tsuyosa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather's face had the strength of someone who had come through many hardships.

notes:
Sense 2 is almost always met in a few written phrases; in conversation, people say ⟦{苦労|くろう}→苦労：02672_kurou⟧ for hardships.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {風雪|ふうせつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{耐|た}える→耐える：12087_taeru⟧: to endure hardships; to weather the years
- {風雪注意報|ふうせつちゅういほう}: snowstorm advisory
- ⟦{幾多|いくた}→幾多：12642_ikuta⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{風雪|ふうせつ}: many trials

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{吹雪|ふぶき}→吹雪：00040_fubuki⟧: blizzard — the everyday word for blowing snow; {風雪|ふうせつ} is more formal and is the word used in weather warnings
